item.title: android/skills
item.description:
Android skills

Android skills are a dedicated repository of AI-optimized, modular instructions and resources, to help agents better understand and execute specific patterns that follow the best practices and guidance on Android development from developer.android.com.

Android skills follow the open-standard agent skills - markdown files (SKILL.md) that provide a technical specification of a task, and ground LLMs with information on specialized domains and workflows.

Our Android skill development focuses on use cases and workflows where evaluations show LLMs underperform. We aren't prioritizing well-established areas where LLMs are already proficient, such as basic Jetpack Compose best practices.

To learn more, read the official documentation:

  • Android skills
  • Android CLI
  • Android Studio

Install Android skills

Use Android CLI to install a specific skill into the current directory:

android skills add r8-analyzer --project=.

Use Android CLI to install all Android skills to directories for all detected agents:

android skills add --all

If you don't have any existing agent directories and don't specify particular agents, the skills will be installed for Gemini and Antigravity at ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills.

Options:

  • --all - Add all Android skills. If omitted, only the android-cli skill will be installed.
  • --agent - A comma-separated list of agents to install the skill for. If omitted, the skill will be installed for all detected agents.
  • --project - Path to a project root in which to install the skills.

To update all skills or specific ones, run:

android skills update --all
android skills update wear-compose-m3

Install as an agent plugin

Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add android/skills
/plugin install android-skills@android-skills

Codex:

codex plugin marketplace add android/skills
codex plugin add android-skills@android-skills

Activate skills

Your agent automatically activates skills that are relevant to your task. To use a skill, prompt your agent to complete a task that is related to the skill, for example "Make my app UI edge-to-edge." The agent should automatically find and use the skill if it has been installed.

Disclaimer

AI can make mistakes, so always double-check the results.

Contributing

Submit a GitHub issue to provide feedback, report issues, or make new skill requests and changes.

Public contributions are not accepted at this time.

License

Android Skills is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. See the LICENSE.txt file for details.

Review our community guidelines

This project follows Google's Open Source Community Guidelines.

BitChord - A modern YouTube music client with clean aesthetics inspired from Apple Music

https://bitchord.kushagrasingh.in/



BitChord

Aesthetic YouTube Music Client



Download · Features · Contributing · Support · Disclaimer


Important

BitChord is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to YouTube or Google in any way. Use it at your own discretion.

Features

Playback

  • Search, browse and play anything available on YouTube Music.
  • Hi-Res lossless audio — FLAC/ALAC from a configured module source, with YouTube Music as fallback.
  • Gapless playback with true crossfade, adjustable 0–12s.
  • Automix [Beta] — DJ-style transitions with beat-matching and tempo-stretching.
  • Offline downloads — save tracks with embedded metadata.
  • Local music library integration.
  • Background playback via a proper foreground media session.
  • Apple-like lyrics animation — credit to binimum.

Connectivity & Accounts

  • Sign in with your Google account for personalized content.

  • Spotify integration — connect your account to play your playlists and Liked Songs.

  • Discord Rich Presence — in-app login, live track/artist/album and progress.

  • Scrobbling to Last.fm and ListenBrainz.

  • Pluggable sources — add, edit, test and health-check module sources.

Experience

  • Animated album canvas — motion artwork on the now-playing screen.
  • Word-synced lyrics — word/syllable-level highlighting from multiple sources.
  • Lyrics providers — credit to lrc.red, BiniLyrics, BetterLyrics, PaxSenix, LyricsPlus, SimpMusic, Unison, Megalobiz, KuGou, LRCLIB, Musixmatch and Genius.
  • Dynamic, artwork-driven theming — Material palette extracted from album art.
  • Frosted-glass UI — Telegram-style translucent bars via Haze, Material 3 theming.

Controls & Tweaks

  • Per-network audio quality — separate quality ceilings for Wi-Fi and mobile data.

  • Playback speed control (0.5×–2.0×) and skip silence.

  • Sleep timer — fixed presets or "stop after this track".

  • System equalizer integration.

  • Bit-perfect USB exclusive output — sends lossless tracks to a USB DAC unchanged, at each track's own rate and bit depth. Thanks to Mornye for the reference.

  • Stats for nerds — codec, bit depth, sample rate, and more on the now-playing screen.

Download

Grab the latest signed APK from the Releases page. Sideloading requires enabling "Install unknown apps" for whichever app you download it with.

Contributing

We welcome contributions to BitChord! Please review our Contributing Guide and Code of Conduct before submitting a Pull Request.

Thanks to all contributors ❤

A Kernel based root solution for Android

https://kernelsu.org

English | Español | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Polski | Português (Brasil) | Türkçe | Русский | Tiếng Việt | Indonesia | עברית | हिंदी | Italiano

KernelSU

A kernel-based root solution for Android devices.

Features

  1. Kernel-based su and root access management.
  2. Module system based on metamodules: Pluggable infrastructure for systemless modifications.
  3. App Profile: Lock up the root power in a cage.

Compatibility state

KernelSU officially supports Android GKI 2.0 devices (kernel 5.10+). Older kernels (4.14+) are also supported, but the kernel will need to be built manually.

With this, WSA, ChromeOS, and container-based Android are all supported.

Currently, the arm64-v8a and x86_64 architectures are supported.

Caution

Recent kernel versions have implemented a breaking change causing KernelSU to fail and potentially trigger a kernel panic on x86_64! Check the website for more info!

Usage

  • Installation
  • How to build
  • Official website

Translation

To help translate KernelSU, we no longer accept translation contributions via Weblate. All translations are now handled using LLMs.

If you would like to add support for a new language, feel free to open a PR. Please note that modifications to existing English and Chinese translations are not accepted.

Discussion

  • Telegram: @KernelSU

Security

For information on reporting security vulnerabilities in KernelSU, see SECURITY.md.

License

  • Files under the kernel directory are GPL-2.0-only.
  • All other parts except the kernel directory are GPL-3.0-or-later.

Credits

  • Kernel-Assisted Superuser: The KernelSU idea.
  • Magisk: The powerful root tool.
  • genuine: APK v2 signature validation.
  • Diamorphine: Some rootkit skills.

item.title: mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android
item.description:
Multi-engine Android VPN — Xray, WARP, Psiphon, Tor, Geph, OpenVPN, MASQUE/AmneziaWG, and the MLM Adaptive Engine that routes each app by its own best path; Cloudflare panels, Config Studio, game booster. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. | اپلیکیشن VPN چندموتورهٔ اندروید با موتور تطبیقی

https://github.com/mlmvpn

MLM VPN — Android

A multi-engine VPN, network scanner and serverless messenger for Android.
Developed and maintained by mlmvpn.

English · فارسی · Русский · 中文


Home
Settings
WireGuard
Gereh
Cloud

English

Overview

MLM VPN brings many independent connection engines together behind one iPhone-style home screen: a V2Ray/Xray client and clean-IP scanner, adaptive engines that find a working route by themselves, more than twenty connection methods for restrictive networks, a full Cloudflare control panel, and Gereh, a messenger that works with no server at all. It is written in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose (minSdk 24, targetSdk 34, compileSdk 36).

⚠️ This project involves network circumvention and VPN technology. Use it in compliance with the laws of your jurisdiction. The maintainers do not encourage or condone illegal use.

Languages

English, فارسی, Русский and 中文 (Russian and Chinese are new in 1.2.43: menus, buttons and messages are translated; part of the text inside some pages is still in English). Choose one in Settings › App Language; Gereh follows it.

Gereh — a phone-to-phone messenger (new in 1.2.43)

  • No server, no phone number, no email. Your identity is a key made on the phone, with a name like ehsan·4821; messages go straight from phone to phone.
  • End-to-end encrypted. Every message, photo and file is sealed on the sender's phone and opened only on the receiver's.
  • Many ways to deliver: a shared Wi-Fi even with no internet, Bluetooth when you are close, the internet through volunteers (users' own phones and computers), and the Google relay — a small mailbox (Apps Script) in the user's own Google account for phones that cannot reach each other, such as one on Irancell and one on MCI. Owners can open their relay to everyone as a public relay; Google and the owner see only sealed bytes.
  • Files in pieces: photos, videos, files and voice messages are cut into equal parts so they get through any route, including the relay.
  • Groups and channels with an owner and admins, settings and member rights, invite links (with or without approval), and the official channel and group «MLMVPN Official» with a member count estimated phone to phone.
  • Add contacts by QR or card link, or «add nearby» with a 4-symbol check. Notifications, chat folders and a home-screen widget; Gereh runs in its own process so its errors never touch the VPN.

Connection engines

  • FLUX — an adaptive engine of its own: races many routes, lets you choose the country and IP version, and proves the real exit after connecting.
  • MAE (MLM Adaptive Engine) — you pick your apps and sites; it learns, per network, which route each one needs and builds foreign exits (a US exit for Gemini and Google Flow) on your own Cloudflare account.
  • V2Ray / Xray client — VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks with REALITY, TLS, WebSocket, gRPC and XHTTP; subscriptions, batch tests and a two-stage clean-IP scanner.
  • WARP, MASQUE, WireGuard and WARP-in-WARP (Aether core) with an exit country of your choice over NAT64, and a standalone WARP engine.
  • Amnezia — free AmneziaWG, WireGuard and Hysteria2 servers, also carried through Cloudflare where the line blocks them.
  • FENIX — Firefox's free VPN on your own Firefox accounts (33 countries, 50 GB a month per account).
  • Proton VPN and Windscribe free servers on your own accounts (every protocol, through WARP where the provider is blocked), Outline keys, OpenVPN (TunnelBear and free .ovpn files) and NPV configs.
  • Psiphon, Tor (with a bridge manager that tests bridges from your line), Geph, Lantern and URnetwork.
  • GitHub Tunnel — your own cloud server on your GitHub account's free allowance; Telegram Proxy on your own Cloudflare; Quick Connect, Iran configs, the SNI anti-filter (with ECH) and server-less domain fronting.

Cloud and tools

  • Cloud panel — connect Cloudflare accounts, deploy self-hosted Worker panels in one tap, fetch their configs and watch daily usage.
  • Cloudflare Doctor — finds where your connection to Cloudflare breaks, trying dozens of ways on your own line, and remembers what works per network.
  • Config Studio — a panel for users, volume, time and device limits on your own Worker, with multi-location exits, plans, templates and endpoints.
  • MLM Scout — tests every method on your line for real and ranks them.
  • Game Booster — measures the route to the game's region and picks the best of your own line, WARP, Amnezia, WireGuard and FENIX; anti-sanction DNS for sign-in and a floating ping over the game.
  • Smart Iran routing, per-app split tunnelling and local network sharing (proxy, hotspot and PAC link for other devices) on every engine.
  • iPhone-style home screen with folders and search, home-screen widgets and Widget Studio, a Quick Settings tile, an engine store with signed updates, backup and restore, and in-app software updates.

Project structure

app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/
├── core/                  # Low-level engine wrappers (aether, warp, tunnel)
└── scanner/
    ├── data/              # Node/subscription/cloud data managers
    ├── engines/           # Pluggable connectivity engines (one dir each)
    ├── mitm/              # On-device CA + server-less domain-fronting profile
    ├── ui/                # Compose screens
    └── utils/             # Config generators, testers, watchdogs
app/src/main/assets/       # Bundled worker scripts, geo data, sanction lists
app/src/main/jniLibs/      # Prebuilt native libraries (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a)

Building

Requirements: Android Studio (recent), a JDK matching the Android Gradle Plugin in build.gradle, and the Android SDK with compileSdk 36.

git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git
cd mlmvpn_android
./gradlew assembleDebug

The debug APK is written to app/build/outputs/apk/debug/.

Native libraries (.so files under app/src/main/jniLibs/) and data files (geoip.dat, geosite.dat) are large and tracked with Git LFS. Install Git LFS and run git lfs pull after cloning if those files show up as small pointer files.

Changelog

See CHANGELOG.md for the full version history (bilingual), or the changelog page.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome — see CONTRIBUTING.md for the project structure, coding conventions, and how to add a new engine.

License & Attribution

This project is licensed under GNU GPLv3, plus an additional term (permitted under GPLv3 §7) requiring attribution — see LICENSE. The project includes GPL source (kittoku/mvc, shadowsocks-android, and Telegram for Android for Gereh's interface), so the whole combined work is GPL. In short:

Any use, fork, or derivative of this project — source or compiled — must clearly credit the original developer, mlmvpn (https://github.com/mlmvpn), wherever the software is presented to end users (About screen, README, store listing, etc.), in addition to the standard GPLv3 obligations (source availability, same license on derivatives, etc.).

فارسی

معرفی

MLM VPN چندین موتور اتصال مستقل را زیر یک صفحهٔ اصلی به سبک آیفون گرد هم می‌آورد: کلاینت V2Ray/Xray و اسکنر آی‌پی تمیز، موتورهای هوشمندی که خودشان راه کارا را پیدا می‌کنند، بیش از بیست روش اتصال برای شبکه‌های محدود، یک پنل کامل کلادفلر، و گره، پیام‌رسانی که هیچ سروری ندارد. با Kotlin و Jetpack Compose نوشته شده است (minSdk 24، targetSdk 34، compileSdk 36).

⚠️ این پروژه با فناوری VPN و دورزدن محدودیت‌های شبکه سروکار دارد. لطفاً مطابق قوانین کشور خود از آن استفاده کنید. توسعه‌دهندگان این پروژه استفادهٔ غیرقانونی را تشویق یا تأیید نمی‌کنند.

زبان‌ها

English، فارسی، Русский و 中文 (روسی و چینی در نسخهٔ ۱.۲.۴۳ اضافه شدند: منوها، دکمه‌ها و پیام‌ها ترجمه شده‌اند و بخشی از متن‌های داخل بعضی صفحه‌ها هنوز انگلیسی است). از تنظیمات › زبان اپلیکیشن انتخاب کنید؛ گره هم همان را دنبال می‌کند.

گره — پیام‌رسان گوشی‌به‌گوشی (تازهٔ نسخهٔ ۱.۲.۴۳)

  • بی سرور، بی شمارهٔ تلفن، بی ایمیل. هویت شما کلیدی است که روی خود گوشی ساخته می‌شود، با نامی مثل ehsan·4821؛ پیام مستقیم از گوشی به گوشی می‌رود.
  • رمزگذاری سرتاسری. هر پیام، عکس و فایل روی گوشی فرستنده مهر می‌شود و فقط روی گوشی گیرنده باز می‌شود.
  • راه‌های زیاد برای رساندن پیام: وای‌فای مشترک حتی بی اینترنت، بلوتوث وقتی کنار هم هستید، اینترنت از راه داوطلبان (گوشی‌ها و رایانه‌های خود کاربران)، و رلهٔ گوگل — صندوقی کوچک (Apps Script) در حساب گوگل خود کاربر برای وقتی که دو گوشی به هم نمی‌رسند، مثلاً یکی ایرانسل و دیگری همراه اول. صاحب رله می‌تواند آن را به‌صورت رلهٔ عمومی برای همه باز کند؛ گوگل و صاحب رله فقط بایت‌های مهرشده می‌بینند.
  • تکه‌تکه کردن فایل‌ها: عکس، ویدیو، فایل و پیام صوتی در تکه‌های هم‌اندازه فرستاده می‌شوند تا از هر راهی، از جمله رله، رد شوند.
  • گروه و کانال با صاحب و مدیران، تنظیمات و اختیارات اعضا، لینک دعوت (با تأیید مدیر یا بی آن)، و کانال و گروه رسمی «MLMVPN رسمی» با شمار اعضایی که گوشی‌به‌گوشی تخمین زده می‌شود.
  • افزودن مخاطب با QR یا لینک کارت، یا «افزودن از نزدیک» با کد تأیید ۴ نمادی. اعلان، پوشه‌های گفت‌وگو و ویجت صفحهٔ اصلی؛ گره در پروسهٔ جدای خودش اجرا می‌شود تا خطایش به VPN آسیب نزند.

موتورهای اتصال

  • FLUX — موتور هوشمند مستقل: راه‌های زیادی را هم‌زمان می‌آزماید، کشور و نسخهٔ IP را به انتخاب شما می‌گذارد و پس از اتصال، خروجی واقعی را ثابت می‌کند.
  • MAE (موتور تطبیقی MLM) — برنامه‌ها و سایت‌هایتان را انتخاب می‌کنید؛ برای هر کدام روی هر شبکه یاد می‌گیرد کدام راه لازم است و خروجی خارجی (از جمله خروجی آمریکا برای جمینای و گوگل فلو) را روی حساب کلادفلر خودتان می‌سازد.
  • کلاینت V2Ray / Xray — VLESS، VMess، Trojan و Shadowsocks با REALITY، TLS، WebSocket، gRPC و XHTTP؛ لینک اشتراک، تست گروهی و اسکنر دومرحله‌ای آی‌پی تمیز.
  • وارپ، ماسک، وایرگارد و وارپ در وارپ (هستهٔ Aether) با کشور خروجی دلخواه از راه NAT64، و موتور مستقل وارپ.
  • آمنزیا — سرورهای رایگان AmneziaWG، WireGuard و Hysteria2، و جایی که خط آن‌ها را می‌بندد، از راه کلادفلر.
  • فنیکس — VPN رایگان فایرفاکس روی حساب‌های فایرفاکس خودتان (۳۳ کشور، ماهی ۵۰ گیگ برای هر حساب).
  • سرورهای رایگان Proton VPN و Windscribe روی حساب خودتان (همهٔ پروتکل‌ها، و از راه وارپ جایی که خودشان بسته‌اند)، کلیدهای Outline، OpenVPN (TunnelBear و فایل‌های رایگان .ovpn) و کانفیگ‌های NPV.
  • سایفون، تور (با مدیریت پل‌ها که پل‌ها را از خط خودتان می‌آزماید)، گف، لنترن و URnetwork.
  • گیت‌هاب تانل — سرور ابری خودتان روی سهمیهٔ رایگان حساب گیت‌هاب؛ پروکسی تلگرام روی کلادفلر خودتان؛ اتصال سریع، کانفیگ‌های ایران، ضدفیلتر SNI (با ECH) و دامین‌فرانتینگ بدون سرور.

ابری و ابزارها

  • پنل ابری — اتصال حساب‌های کلادفلر، استقرار یک‌لمسی پنل‌های ورکر خوداستقرار، دریافت کانفیگ‌هایشان و پایش مصرف روزانه.
  • دکتر کلادفلر — پیدا می‌کند اتصال شما به کلادفلر کجا می‌شکند، با ده‌ها روش روی خط خودتان، و آنچه کار می‌کند را برای هر شبکه به خاطر می‌سپارد.
  • کانفیگ استدیو — پنل کاربر، حجم، زمان و سقف دستگاه روی ورکر خودتان، با خروجی چندکشوری، بسته‌ها، قالب‌ها و نقطه‌های اتصال.
  • MLM Scout — همهٔ روش‌ها را واقعاً روی خط شما می‌آزماید و رتبه‌بندی می‌کند.
  • گیم بوستر — مسیر تا منطقهٔ بازی را اندازه می‌گیرد و بهترین را از میان خط خودتان، وارپ، آمنزیا، وایرگارد و فنیکس برمی‌گزیند؛ DNS ضدتحریم برای ورود و پینگ شناور روی بازی.
  • مسیریابی هوشمند ایران، تونل جداگانه برای هر برنامه و اشتراک در شبکهٔ محلی (پروکسی، هات‌اسپات و لینک PAC برای دستگاه‌های دیگر) روی همهٔ موتورها.
  • صفحهٔ اصلی به سبک آیفون با پوشه و جستجو، ویجت‌های صفحهٔ اصلی و ویجت استدیو، کاشی تنظیمات سریع، استور موتورها با به‌روزرسانی امضاشده، پشتیبان‌گیری و بازگردانی، و به‌روزرسانی برنامه از داخل خودش.

ساختار پروژه

app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/
├── core/                  # لایه‌های پایهٔ موتورها (aether، warp، tunnel)
└── scanner/
    ├── data/              # مدیریت دادهٔ نود/اشتراک/کلاود
    ├── engines/           # موتورهای اتصال (هر کدام یک پوشه)
    ├── mitm/              # گواهی روی گوشی + پروفایل دامین‌فرانتینگ بدون سرور
    ├── ui/                # صفحه‌های Compose
    └── utils/             # تولیدکننده‌های کانفیگ، تسترها، واچ‌داگ‌ها
app/src/main/assets/       # اسکریپت‌های ورکر، دادهٔ جغرافیایی، فهرست تحریم
app/src/main/jniLibs/      # کتابخانه‌های native از پیش ساخته‌شده

ساخت پروژه

پیش‌نیازها: Android Studio (نسخهٔ اخیر)، JDK متناسب با Android Gradle Plugin در build.gradle، و Android SDK با compileSdk 36.

git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git
cd mlmvpn_android
./gradlew assembleDebug

فایل APK دیباگ در app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ ساخته می‌شود.

کتابخانه‌های native (فایل‌های .so در app/src/main/jniLibs/) و فایل‌های داده (geoip.dat، geosite.dat) حجیم‌اند و با Git LFS نگه‌داری می‌شوند. پس از clone، Git LFS را نصب و git lfs pull را اجرا کنید.

فهرست تغییرات

تاریخچهٔ کامل نسخه‌ها (دوزبانه) در CHANGELOG.md و صفحهٔ تغییرات است.

مشارکت

مجوز و ذکر منبع

این پروژه تحت GNU GPLv3 به‌همراه یک شرط اضافه (مجاز طبق ماده §۷ خود GPLv3) که ذکر منبع را الزامی می‌کند منتشر شده است — LICENSE را ببینید. پروژه سورس GPL (kittoku/mvc، shadowsocks-android، و تلگرام اندروید برای رابط گره) را در خود دارد، پس کل اثر ترکیبی GPL است. به‌طور خلاصه:

هرگونه استفاده، فورک یا اثر مشتق‌شده از این پروژه — چه سورس و چه کامپایل‌شده — باید هرجا که نرم‌افزار به کاربر نهایی نمایش داده می‌شود (صفحهٔ درباره، README، صفحهٔ فروشگاه و غیره) به‌طور واضح توسعه‌دهندهٔ اصلی، mlmvpn (https://github.com/mlmvpn)، را ذکر کند؛ افزون بر الزام‌های معمول GPLv3 (در دسترس بودن سورس، همان مجوز برای آثار مشتق و غیره).

Русский

Обзор

MLM VPN объединяет множество независимых движков подключения на одном главном экране в стиле iPhone: клиент V2Ray/Xray и сканер чистых IP, адаптивные движки, которые сами находят рабочий маршрут, более двадцати способов подключения для сетей с ограничениями, полноценную панель Cloudflare и Gereh — мессенджер, которому вообще не нужен сервер. Написан на Kotlin и Jetpack Compose (minSdk 24, targetSdk 34, compileSdk 36).

⚠️ Проект связан с технологиями VPN и обхода сетевых ограничений. Используйте его в соответствии с законами вашей страны. Разработчики не поощряют и не одобряют незаконное использование.

Языки

English, فارسی, Русский и 中文 (русский и китайский появились в 1.2.43: переведены меню, кнопки и сообщения; часть текста внутри некоторых страниц пока на английском). Выберите язык в Настройки › Язык приложения; Gereh следует ему.

Gereh — мессенджер от телефона к телефону (новое в 1.2.43)

  • Без сервера, без номера телефона, без email. Ваша идентичность — ключ, созданный на телефоне, с именем вроде ehsan·4821; сообщения идут напрямую с телефона на телефон.
  • Сквозное шифрование. Каждое сообщение, фото и файл запечатываются на телефоне отправителя и открываются только на телефоне получателя.
  • Много путей доставки: общий Wi-Fi даже без интернета, Bluetooth рядом, интернет через волонтёров (телефоны и компьютеры самих пользователей) и ретранслятор Google — маленький почтовый ящик (Apps Script) в собственном аккаунте Google пользователя для телефонов, которые не могут связаться напрямую, например в Irancell и MCI. Владелец может открыть свой ретранслятор для всех как публичный; Google и владелец видят только запечатанные байты.
  • Файлы по частям: фото, видео, файлы и голосовые сообщения режутся на равные части, чтобы пройти любым путём, включая ретранслятор.
  • Группы и каналы с владельцем и администраторами, настройками и правами участников, ссылки-приглашения (с одобрением или без), официальный канал и группа «MLMVPN Official» с числом участников, оцениваемым от телефона к телефону.
  • Контакты добавляются по QR-коду или ссылке на карточку либо «рядом» с проверкой по 4 символам. Уведомления, папки чатов и виджет главного экрана; Gereh работает в отдельном процессе, поэтому его ошибки не затрагивают VPN.

Движки подключения

  • FLUX — собственный адаптивный движок: перебирает множество маршрутов, позволяет выбрать страну и версию IP и проверяет реальный выход после подключения.
  • MAE (MLM Adaptive Engine) — вы выбираете свои приложения и сайты; он узнаёт для каждой сети, какой маршрут нужен каждому, и создаёт зарубежные выходы (в том числе выход в США для Gemini и Google Flow) в вашем аккаунте Cloudflare.
  • Клиент V2Ray / Xray — VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks с REALITY, TLS, WebSocket, gRPC и XHTTP; подписки, пакетные проверки и двухэтапный сканер чистых IP.
  • WARP, MASQUE, WireGuard и WARP-в-WARP (ядро Aether) с выбором страны выхода через NAT64, а также отдельный движок WARP.
  • Amnezia — бесплатные серверы AmneziaWG, WireGuard и Hysteria2, а там, где линия их блокирует, — через Cloudflare.
  • FENIX — бесплатный VPN Firefox на ваших собственных аккаунтах Firefox (33 страны, 50 ГБ в месяц на аккаунт).
  • Бесплатные серверы Proton VPN и Windscribe на ваших аккаунтах (все протоколы, через WARP там, где провайдер заблокирован), ключи Outline, OpenVPN (TunnelBear и бесплатные файлы .ovpn) и конфиги NPV.
  • Psiphon, Tor (с менеджером мостов, который проверяет мосты с вашей линии), Geph, Lantern и URnetwork.
  • GitHub-туннель — ваш собственный облачный сервер на бесплатной квоте аккаунта GitHub; прокси Telegram на вашем Cloudflare; быстрое подключение, иранские конфиги, обход фильтров SNI (с ECH) и domain fronting без сервера.

Облако и инструменты

  • Облачная панель — подключение аккаунтов Cloudflare, развёртывание собственных панелей на Worker в одно нажатие, получение их конфигов и контроль дневного использования.
  • Cloudflare Doctor — находит, где обрывается ваше соединение с Cloudflare, пробуя десятки способов на вашей линии, и запоминает рабочий для каждой сети.
  • Config Studio — панель пользователей, трафика, сроков и лимитов устройств на вашем Worker, с многолокационными выходами, тарифами, шаблонами и точками подключения.
  • MLM Scout — реально проверяет каждый способ на вашей линии и ранжирует их.
  • Game Booster — измеряет маршрут до региона игры и выбирает лучший из вашей линии, WARP, Amnezia, WireGuard и FENIX; DNS против санкций для входа и плавающий пинг поверх игры.
  • Умная маршрутизация Ирана, раздельное туннелирование по приложениям и общий доступ по локальной сети (прокси, точка доступа и ссылка PAC для других устройств) на всех движках.
  • Главный экран в стиле iPhone с папками и поиском, виджеты главного экрана и Widget Studio, плитка быстрых настроек, магазин движков с подписанными обновлениями, резервное копирование и восстановление, обновление приложения изнутри.

Структура проекта

app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/
├── core/                  # Низкоуровневые обёртки движков (aether, warp, tunnel)
└── scanner/
    ├── data/              # Управление данными узлов/подписок/облака
    ├── engines/           # Подключаемые движки (по папке на каждый)
    ├── mitm/              # CA на устройстве + профиль domain fronting без сервера
    ├── ui/                # Экраны Compose
    └── utils/             # Генераторы конфигов, тестеры, сторожевые таймеры
app/src/main/assets/       # Скрипты воркеров, гео-данные, списки санкций
app/src/main/jniLibs/      # Готовые нативные библиотеки

Сборка

Требования: Android Studio (свежая версия), JDK под Android Gradle Plugin из build.gradle и Android SDK с compileSdk 36.

git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git
cd mlmvpn_android
./gradlew assembleDebug

Отладочный APK появится в app/build/outputs/apk/debug/.

Нативные библиотеки (файлы .so в app/src/main/jniLibs/) и файлы данных (geoip.dat, geosite.dat) большие и хранятся в Git LFS. Установите Git LFS и после клонирования выполните git lfs pull.

История изменений

Полная история версий (на двух языках) — в CHANGELOG.md и на странице изменений.

Участие

Мы рады вкладу — в CONTRIBUTING.md описаны структура проекта, правила оформления кода и добавление нового движка.

Лицензия и указание авторства

Проект распространяется под GNU GPLv3 с дополнительным условием (разрешённым §7 GPLv3) об указании авторства — см. LICENSE. В проект входит исходный код под GPL (kittoku/mvc, shadowsocks-android и Telegram for Android для интерфейса Gereh), поэтому всё совместное произведение распространяется под GPL. Кратко:

中文

概述

MLM VPN 在一个 iPhone 风格的主屏幕上集合了多个独立的连接引擎：V2Ray/Xray 客户端和干净 IP 扫描器、能自己找到可用路由的自适应引擎、二十多种面向受限网络 的连接方式、完整的 Cloudflare 控制面板，以及完全不需要服务器的通讯工具 Gereh。使用 Kotlin 和 Jetpack Compose 编写（minSdk 24、targetSdk 34、 compileSdk 36）。

⚠️ 本项目涉及网络规避和 VPN 技术。请遵守你所在地区的法律使用。维护者不鼓励 也不认可任何非法用途。

语言

English、فارسی、Русский 和 中文（俄语和中文是 1.2.43 新增的：菜单、按钮 和提示已翻译，部分页面内的文字仍为英文）。在 设置 › 应用语言 中选择；Gereh 会 跟随该设置。

Gereh——手机到手机的通讯工具（1.2.43 新增）

  • 无服务器、无需手机号、无需邮箱。 你的身份是在手机上生成的密钥，名字形如 ehsan·4821；消息直接从一部手机发到另一部手机。
  • 端到端加密。 每条消息、照片和文件都在发送者手机上密封，只在接收者手机上打开。
  • 多种送达方式： 共享 Wi-Fi（即使没有互联网）、近距离蓝牙、通过志愿者 （用户自己的手机和电脑）走互联网，以及 Google 中继——用户自己 Google 账户 中的一个小邮箱（Apps Script），用于无法互相联系的手机，例如一部使用 Irancell、 一部使用 MCI。所有者可以把中继作为公共中继向所有人开放；Google 和所有者 只能看到密封的字节。
  • 文件分块传输： 照片、视频、文件和语音消息被切成等大的块，可以通过任何 路径传递，包括中继。
  • 群组和频道，有所有者和管理员、设置和成员权限、邀请链接（可选审批）， 以及官方频道和群组「MLMVPN Official」，成员数在手机之间估算。
  • 通过二维码或名片链接添加联系人，或用「添加附近的人」并核对 4 个符号。 支持通知、聊天文件夹和主屏幕小部件；Gereh 在独立进程中运行，其错误不会影响 VPN。

连接引擎

  • FLUX——独立的自适应引擎：同时竞速多条路由，可选择国家和 IP 版本，连接后 验证真实出口。
  • MAE（MLM Adaptive Engine）——你选择常用的应用和网站；它针对每个网络学习 每个应用需要哪条路由，并在你自己的 Cloudflare 账户上建立境外出口（包括供 Gemini 和 Google Flow 使用的美国出口）。
  • V2Ray / Xray 客户端——VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Shadowsocks，支持 REALITY、 TLS、WebSocket、gRPC 和 XHTTP；订阅、批量测试和两阶段干净 IP 扫描器。
  • WARP、MASQUE、WireGuard 和 WARP-in-WARP（Aether 内核），可通过 NAT64 选择出口国家；另有独立的 WARP 引擎。
  • Amnezia——免费的 AmneziaWG、WireGuard 和 Hysteria2 服务器，在线路封锁 它们的地方经由 Cloudflare。
  • FENIX——在你自己的 Firefox 账户上使用 Firefox 的免费 VPN（33 个国家， 每个账户每月 50 GB）。
  • 你自己账户上的 Proton VPN 和 Windscribe 免费服务器（所有协议，在 服务商被封锁时经由 WARP）、Outline 密钥、OpenVPN（TunnelBear 和免费 .ovpn 文件）以及 NPV 配置。
  • Psiphon、Tor（带网桥管理器，从你的线路测试网桥）、Geph、 Lantern 和 URnetwork。
  • GitHub 隧道——在你 GitHub 账户的免费额度上运行你自己的云服务器；你自己 Cloudflare 上的 Telegram 代理；快速连接、伊朗配置、SNI 反过滤（支持 ECH）和无服务器域前置。

云与工具

  • 云面板——连接 Cloudflare 账户，一键部署自托管的 Worker 面板，获取其配置 并查看每日用量。
  • Cloudflare Doctor——在你自己的线路上尝试几十种方式，找出你与 Cloudflare 的连接在哪里中断，并为每个网络记住可用的方式。
  • Config Studio——在你自己的 Worker 上管理用户、流量、时间和设备限制的面板， 支持多位置出口、套餐、模板和端点。
  • MLM Scout——在你的线路上真实测试每一种方式并排名。
  • Game Booster（游戏加速器）——测量到游戏区域的路由，从你自己的线路、WARP、 Amnezia、WireGuard 和 FENIX 中选出最佳；提供用于登录的反制裁 DNS 和游戏上方 的悬浮 ping。
  • 所有引擎都支持 伊朗智能路由、按应用分流和 局域网共享（为其他设备提供 代理、热点和 PAC 链接）。
  • iPhone 风格的主屏幕（文件夹和搜索）、主屏幕小部件和 Widget Studio、快速 设置图块、带签名更新的引擎商店、备份与恢复，以及应用内软件更新。

项目结构

app/src/main/java/com/mlmvpn/
├── core/                  # 底层引擎封装（aether、warp、tunnel）
└── scanner/
    ├── data/              # 节点/订阅/云数据管理
    ├── engines/           # 可插拔的连接引擎（每个一个目录）
    ├── mitm/              # 设备上的 CA + 无服务器域前置配置
    ├── ui/                # Compose 界面
    └── utils/             # 配置生成器、测试器、看门狗
app/src/main/assets/       # Worker 脚本、地理数据、制裁列表
app/src/main/jniLibs/      # 预编译的原生库

构建

要求：较新的 Android Studio、与 build.gradle 中 Android Gradle Plugin 匹配的 JDK，以及安装了 compileSdk 36 的 Android SDK。

git clone https://github.com/mlmvpn/mlmvpn_android.git
cd mlmvpn_android
./gradlew assembleDebug

调试版 APK 位于 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/。

原生库（app/src/main/jniLibs/ 下的 .so 文件）和数据文件（geoip.dat、 geosite.dat）体积较大，使用 Git LFS 管理。克隆后请安装 Git LFS 并运行 git lfs pull。

更新日志

完整的版本历史（双语）见 CHANGELOG.md 和 更新日志页面。

参与贡献

欢迎贡献——项目结构、代码规范以及如何添加新引擎，请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md。

许可与署名

本项目采用 GNU GPLv3 许可，并附加一项署名条款（GPLv3 第 7 条允许）——见 LICENSE。项目包含 GPL 源代码（kittoku/mvc、shadowsocks-android， 以及用于 Gereh 界面的 Telegram for Android），因此整个组合作品均为 GPL。简而言之：

对本项目的任何使用、分叉或衍生作品——无论是源代码还是编译后的形式——都必须 在向最终用户展示软件的任何地方（关于页面、README、商店页面等）明确注明原始 开发者 mlmvpn（https://github.com/mlmvpn），同时遵守 GPLv3 的标准义务 （提供源代码、衍生作品使用相同许可等）。

item.title: YuKongA/ghostlock-app
item.description:
GhostLock One-Tap Execution App (CVE-2026-43499)

GhostLock-App

中文

GhostLock uses CVE-2026-43499 to gain temporary root on supported Android kernels and load KernelSU.

Use the app

  1. Install a root manager APK from KernelSU, BakaSU/ReSukiSU, or KowSU.
  2. Install the GhostLock APK and open it.
  3. Check that your kernel is supported, then tap Run.

Support requires an exact uname -r match. Check the supported devices for your kernel build.

If Shizuku is enabled, start it with ADB before running GhostLock. Tap GhostLock's status card to grant access.

Any root manager that ships libksud.so provides ksud for module loading. The built-in list (KernelSU, ReSukiSU, BakaSU, KowSU) is auto-detected, and other managers can be picked in Settings → Root manager. Without ksud, W1/W2 still grant uid 0 but no module is loaded.

Add a kernel profile

You can import a profile without rebuilding the app:

  • Parse OTA link accepts a full OTA ZIP URL.
  • Parse local image accepts boot.img and an optional xbl_config.img.
  • Import offsets.conf (v2) accepts a HOCON profile. Import offsets.json (v1) converts an older JSON report in the app.

Extractor output is an unverified candidate. The app checks missing or invalid fields before execution. Generating a profile does not prove device support. See the porting guide for validation and built-in registration.

See the MediaTek guide for image-based address recovery and the rooted-device fallback.

Command-line tools

Run the native binary with an exported profile

Requires the Android NDK, make, Gradle, and ADB. An adb shell run skips the app's seccomp bypass stage.

make -C src ghostlock
./gradlew exportKernelProfiles
adb push build/native/ghostlock /data/local/tmp/ghostlock
adb push "build/kernel-profiles/<release>.bin" /data/local/tmp/profile.bin
adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/ghostlock
adb shell /data/local/tmp/ghostlock --load-prebuilt-profile /data/local/tmp/profile.bin
Build and run the offset extractor

Requires Rust. The extractor accepts a boot image, a full OTA ZIP, or an HTTP(S) URL.

(cd tools/extract_rs && cargo build --release)
build/extract/release/ghostlock-extract boot.img --xbl-config xbl_config.img --format conf --out profile.conf
build/extract/release/ghostlock-extract OTA.zip --format conf --out profile.conf

Import profile.conf in the app. Omit --xbl-config if you do not have that image. The extractor rejects a patched remove_waiter() with exit code 6.

Reference

  • Profile schema and execution defaults
  • Native core
  • Add a component, engineering rules, and writing rules

DroidDesk turns your Android phone into a real Linux desktop using Termux, Termux X11, TUR, and Proot. Run VS Code, Firefox, LibreOffice, Blender, and more with X11 or VNC support for monitor setup.

DroidDesk

Run a full Linux desktop on any Android phone. Not a terminal. Not an emulator. A complete desktop environment with direct kernel access -- VS Code, Blender, Metasploit, local AI, all of it.

Connect your phone to a monitor and it becomes a Linux PC. Unplug it and your entire setup comes with you.

Important

DroidDesk is an independent GPL-3.0 open-source project that incorporates modified Termux:X11 components. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Termux, Termux:X11, TUR, Canonical, or Ubuntu.

  • Source and licenses: https://github.com/orailnoor/DroidDesk
  • Termux:X11 upstream: https://github.com/termux/termux-x11

What This Actually Runs

Everything below has been tested and confirmed working:

  • LibreOffice -- Word processing, spreadsheets, presentations. Fully functional.
  • VS Code -- Full version. Python, PIP, extensions, everything.
  • Claude Code -- AI coding agent running directly in terminal.
  • Blender -- Installs and opens. Laggy on mobile hardware, but it runs.
  • Wireshark -- Full network analysis, every packet and protocol.
  • Metasploit -- Pentesting framework, runs fine.
  • Local AI -- Offline LLM inference, 5+ tokens/second, no API needed.

If it runs on Ubuntu, it runs here.

How It Works

The Linux environment runs through Termux with direct access to the phone's kernel. No emulation, no translation -- native performance.

The setup script installs a full desktop (XFCE4/LXQt/MATE/KDE) inside Termux using the Termux User Repository (TUR) for GUI apps. For tools not available in TUR (Wireshark, Metasploit, etc.), a Proot container provides a standard Ubuntu/Debian/Kali environment where you install anything with apt.

The automatic menu sync scans what you install inside Proot and adds it directly to your desktop app menu. No need to enter the container every time.

DroidDesk App (Standalone)

DroidDesk is also available as a standalone Android application that completely automates this process without requiring a separate Termux installation. It renders through an embedded Termux:X11 server running in its own Android process; the app does not use VNC.

  • Rooted phones: Run the Ubuntu filesystem through chroot.
  • Non-rooted phones: Run an app-private native Termux userspace and install desktop packages from the X11 and TUR repositories. PRoot is not used.
  • Rendering: Both modes connect directly to the embedded X11 server on DISPLAY=:0. Adreno devices use Turnip/Zink hardware acceleration when available; other GPUs fall back to Mesa software rendering.
  • Automated setup: The app extracts the bundled ARM64 Termux bootstrap, configures its private package prefix, and installs the selected desktop automatically.

Download the latest release APK from the Releases tab and sideload it to begin.

Requirements

  • Any Android phone (ARM64)
  • Termux (install from F-Droid, not Play Store)
  • Termux-X11 (for on-phone display)

For Monitor Output ( Optional )

Option A: USB-C Display Output If your phone supports display output over USB-C, just use a USB-C to HDMI adapter. Done.

Option B: Raspberry Pi Bridge For phones without display output (most mid-range phones with USB 2.0), use a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W as a bridge:

  • Raspberry Pi Zero 2W with Raspberry Pi OS
  • Micro USB to USB-C cable
  • USB-C hub
  • Micro HDMI to HDMI adapter
  • SD card with Pi firmware
  • Wireless keyboard and mouse

The Pi connects to the phone via USB tethering, detects the phone's IP automatically, and opens a VNC viewer to display the phone's desktop on the monitor.

Installation

Step 1: Install Termux

Download and install Termux from F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/en/packages/com.termux/

Do NOT use the Play Store version. It is outdated and will not work.

Step 2: Install Termux-X11

Download the latest APK from: https://github.com/termux/termux-x11/releases/tag/nightly

Install it on your phone. This is the display server that renders the desktop.

Step 3: Run the Setup Script

Open Termux and run:

curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orailnoor/DroidDesk/main/termux-linux-setup.sh -o setup.sh
bash setup.sh

The script will:

  1. Update Termux packages
  2. Add X11 and TUR repositories
  3. Install your chosen desktop environment (XFCE4/LXQt/MATE/KDE)
  4. Set up GPU acceleration (Turnip for Adreno, Zink fallback for others)
  5. Install Firefox, Git, Python, and core tools
  6. Set up a Proot Linux container (Ubuntu/Debian/Kali)
  7. Create the App Bridge for automatic menu syncing
  8. Apply a modern dark theme
  9. Optionally set up VNC for remote access

Step 4: Start the Desktop

After installation completes:

bash ~/start-x11.sh

Then open the Termux-X11 app on your phone. Your desktop is ready.

Step 5: Install Apps Inside Proot

To install tools that are not in TUR:

bash ~/start-proot.sh
apt install wireshark    # or any other package
exit
bash ~/proot-menu-sync.sh

The app will appear in your desktop menu automatically.

Raspberry Pi Monitor Bridge Setup

If you are using a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W to output to a monitor:

Step 1: Flash Raspberry Pi OS

Flash standard Raspberry Pi OS to an SD card and boot the Pi.

Step 2: Install VNC Viewer on the Pi

sudo apt update
sudo apt install realvnc-vnc-viewer

Step 3: Copy the Launcher Script

Copy pi-launch_phone.sh to your Pi:

curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orailnoor/DroidDesk/main/pi-launch_phone.sh -o ~/pi-launch_phone.sh
chmod +x ~/pi-launch_phone.sh

Step 4: Connect and Launch

  1. Connect the phone to the Pi via USB cable
  2. Enable USB Tethering on the phone
  3. Start VNC on the phone: bash ~/start-vnc.sh (in Termux)
  4. Run the bridge script on the Pi:
bash ~/pi-launch_phone.sh

The script auto-detects the phone's IP and opens a fullscreen VNC session on the monitor.

Optional: Auto-Launch on Boot

To make the Pi automatically connect when powered on, add to crontab:

crontab -e

Add this line:

@reboot sleep 15 && /home/pi/pi-launch_phone.sh

Commands Reference

Command What It Does
bash ~/start-x11.sh Start desktop via Termux-X11
bash ~/start-vnc.sh Start desktop via VNC (if installed)
bash ~/start-proot.sh Open Proot Linux shell
bash ~/proot-menu-sync.sh Sync Proot apps to desktop menu
bash ~/stop-linux.sh Stop all sessions

Notes

Warning

Disable Child Process in Developer Options On some Android versions (MIUI, One UI, stock Android 13+), the system may kill Termux background processes and drop your desktop session. To prevent this:

  1. Go to Settings → Developer Options
  2. Find "Child process" (may be labeled differently depending on your ROM)
  3. Disable child process restrictions for Termux

Without this, long-running sessions (VNC, Termux-X11) may be killed by the OS without warning.

  • Termux-X11 directly on the phone is faster than VNC. Use VNC only when you need monitor output through the Pi bridge or remote access from another device.
  • For standalone phone use without a monitor, Termux-X11 is the recommended option.
  • The Proot container shares the display with the native Termux desktop. Apps installed in Proot render on the same screen.
  • GPU acceleration works best on Adreno GPUs (Qualcomm Snapdragon phones). Other GPUs fall back to software rendering.

Credits

Created by orailnoor

License and third-party software

The Android application incorporates GPL-licensed Termux:X11 components and bundles other third-party software under their respective licenses. See:

item.description:
Kernel-based Android Root Solution & KPM

https://SukiSU.org

SukiSU Ultra

Current branch: main (active development) · Forked from KernelSU, independently maintained

English | 简体中文

A kernel-based root solution for Android devices, forked from tiann/KernelSU, with some interesting changes added.

Features

  1. Kernel-based su and root access management
  2. App Profile: Lock up the root power in a cage
  3. Support non-GKI and GKI 1.0
  4. KPM Support
  5. Built-in susfs management tool for one-click root hiding configuration; customizable manager theme.

Compatibility Status

  • SukiSU Ultra supports Android GKI 2.0 devices (kernel 5.10+).
  • Older kernels (4.14+) are also compatible, but the kernel will have to be built manually.
  • With more backports, kernels 3.x (3.4–3.18) can be supported.
  • Currently, only arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a (bare) and X86_64 (some) are supported.
  • Note: Since forking from tiann/KernelSU, this project has evolved independently. Compatibility is based on actual testing in this repository and no longer equals KernelSU's official support scope.

Installation

Choose the installation method based on your device:

Scenario Method Notes
GKI device (kernel 5.10+) Flash boot image See guide/installation.md
Non-GKI / older kernel (4.14+) Build kernel manually See guide/how-to-integrate.md
Need KPM features Enable CONFIG_KPM=y See "KPM Support" below

Detailed steps: guide/installation.md

Integration

See guide/how-to-integrate.md

KPM Support

Based on KernelPatch, we removed features redundant with KSU and retained only KPM support.

Current status:

  • ✅ Basic KPM loading is available (requires CONFIG_KPM=y)
  • 🚧 APatch compatibility expansion is in progress (some features not yet merged)
  • ⚠️ Non-GKI devices additionally require CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y
  • ⚠️ Kernels below 4.19 require backporting set_memory.h from 4.19

Open-source repository: ShirkNeko/SukiSU_KernelPatch_patch
KPM template: udochina/KPM-Build-Anywhere

Troubleshooting

  1. Device stuck after uninstalling the manager app?
    Uninstall _com.sony.playmemories.mobile_.

  2. KPM fails to load?
    Confirm the kernel has CONFIG_KPM=y enabled; Non-GKI devices also need CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y.

  3. Manager cannot detect root?
    Confirm the flashed kernel matches the manager version, and check that su is in PATH.

  4. Kernel build errors?
    Refer to guide/how-to-integrate.md, and confirm the kernel version meets the minimum requirement (4.14+).

item.title: ahXN00/OwnTV
item.description:
Native Android TV IPTV player — Kotlin, Compose for TV, ExoPlayer + mpv. Xtream, M3U and Stalker portals, EPG, catch-up TV, profiles and downloads.

https://t.me/owntvplayer

Your own IPTV player for Android TV
Fast · modern · remote-first — bring your own M3U, Xtream or Stalker (MAC) sources

OwnTV is a native Android TV IPTV player, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for TV. It runs two playback engines — libmpv (FFmpeg) for the widest compatibility, ExoPlayer (Media3) for near-instant Live TV — and it is a player only: you bring your own Xtream login, M3U playlist (URL or a local file) or Stalker/Ministra portal.

⚠️ OwnTV ships no channels, playlists, subscriptions or streams. You are responsible for the sources you add.

Open source, GPLv3, original code, built with the help of AI. Android TV only — leanback launcher, D-pad first.

📖 New here? User Guide →

Every feature, where to find it, and the remote shortcuts — on one page.

💬 Community

Questions, ideas, bug reports — join the OwnTV Telegram group:

👉 t.me/owntvplayer

✨ Features

🎬 Playback

  • Two engines — mpv for compatibility, ExoPlayer for instant Live TV, with automatic fallback and a per-channel override
  • 4K HDR direct rendering, optional auto frame-rate matching, surround sound with a stereo safety net, 150% volume boost
  • Subtitles — text, image and closed captions, plus OpenSubtitles search and local files
  • Resume, next-episode auto-play, mini-player/PiP, picture-in-picture when you press Home, audio-only mode, live stream-info overlay
  • Media-session transport keys and proper audio focus — it behaves like a TV app
  • An error log you can export for any stream that misbehaves

🧭 Browse

  • Home with Continue Watching and Now Trending (TMDB rankings matched to what your provider can actually play)
  • Live TV · Movies · Series · Downloads · Guide, with per-profile row order, Favorites, History and search (voice search where the TV has a speech recogniser)
  • Multiple playlists at once, with provider labels everywhere they could be confused
  • Rename, hide, reorder and combine categories; bulk rename rules
  • TMDB posters, plots, cast and trailers in 40 languages — scales to ~50k channels / ~168k movies
  • Two layouts for Movies & Series — the classic three panels, or Cinematic: the focused title's artwork full-bleed behind the whole screen, with its details and cast above a wide poster grid
  • Adjustable panel widths per section, including hiding the preview pane entirely

📥 Sources & EPG

  • Xtream, M3U and Stalker/Ministra — add any of them from your phone over Wi-Fi (QR + PIN)
  • TV Guide (XMLTV) with a live Now marker, multiple guide sources and automatic channel matching
  • Catch-up TV up to 7 days, live rewind, and Go back to… even for channels with no guide
  • Guide time offset, per-source guide logos, per-channel EPG fixes
  • Protected (DRM) channels — Widevine and ClearKey, read from the playlist, nothing to configure
  • Custom DNS (Google, Cloudflare, Quad9, DoH or your own)

⏺️ Recording & Multiview

  • Record live TV from the guide, the channel list or while watching — including every showing of a programme
  • Multiview — up to four channels at once, with one carrying the sound
  • OwnTV measures how many streams your provider allows and warns before it refuses one

👥 Profiles & Downloads

  • Multiple profiles with their own favourites, history and resume points, PIN locks and a Kids mode; lock single categories behind a PIN, and optionally Settings too
  • Per-profile startup: Home, last channel, the last channel in the TV Guide or Live TV, Favorites, or one chosen channel
  • Offline movies and episodes with pause, resume, retry and a storage bar

🎨 Look & robustness

  • Your own accent colour and focus highlight, frosted Glass with adjustable opacity, and a Stage, Picture or Plain background
  • Dark and Light themes (or follow the TV) across the whole app, the player included
  • Font sizing for the interface and for popups, independently
  • Remote Shortcuts — map spare colour, number, channel and media keys to 26 actions; Player buttons choose what OK and a held OK do in the player, swap channel up/down, and turn number keys off
  • Menu labels — the section names beside the menu icons: off, when focused, or always
  • 26 interface languages, RTL-aware, chosen before anything else on a fresh install
  • Backup & Restore to a single .own file, optionally encrypted, locally or over Wi-Fi
  • Set up from another device — a new box copies everything from the OwnTV device you already have over your own Wi-Fi, offered on the first setup screen rather than buried in the menus
  • In-app updates; memory-safe lists, auto-reconnect and offline detection throughout

📸 Screenshots


Home — Continue Watching
Live TV — preview playing

TV Guide (EPG)
Settings

More in extras/screenshots/.

🧱 Tech stack

Area Choice
Language Kotlin 2.4.20 (no kotlin-android plugin)
Build AGP 9.4.0 / Gradle 9.7.1, KSP2 2.3.11
UI Jetpack Compose for TV (androidx.tv:tv-material 1.1.0), Compose BOM 2026.08.00
Media libmpv (FFmpeg) · ExoPlayer/Media3 1.11.1
Database Room 2.8.5 + Paging 3.5.1 + FTS4
DI · Network · Images Koin 4.2.2 · OkHttp 5 · Coil 3.6.0

minSdk 26, targetSdk 36, compileSdk 37, applicationId tv.own.owntv.

Build note: there is no kotlin-android plugin. AGP 9 ships its own Kotlin, but the Compose compiler plugin pulls the Kotlin Gradle plugin up to the kotlin version in gradle/libs.versions.toml — that is what compiles the app, so keep the Compose compiler plugin on exactly that version. KSP versions independently and does not have to match it.

⚙️ How it works

  • Parsing & sync — M3U is line-streamed and Xtream JSON is read with JsonReader, so a huge provider payload is never fully buffered. Refresh is chunked, cancellable and reports progress.
  • Storage — a 27-entity Room schema with FTS4 search; Paging 3 with a bounded size keeps memory flat across 50k-item lists.
  • EPG — XMLTV is stream-parsed (gzip-aware) into a rolling window and pruned.
  • Player — two engines behind one PlaybackEngine interface, with a four-rung fallback ladder. Live promotes the running preview straight to full screen with no reload.
  • DI — Koin modules.

Project layout

This repository is the Android TV app. Everything underneath it — database, sync, parsers, EPG, backup, settings storage, the playback engines and every translated string — is a separate core library, shared with the OwnTV Mobile app for phones and tablets.

OwnTV/  (this repo)
tv.own.owntv/
├── player/      the TV player HUD, surfaces and mini-player
├── ui/          theme + reusable components
├── features/    setup, shell, live, movies, series, search, downloads, epg, profiles, settings
└── di/          Koin modules

OwnTV_Core/  (separate repo, published as tv.own.owntv:core / :player-core)
├── core/        database, network, parsers, Stalker, repository, sync, strings
└── player-core/ libmpv + ExoPlayer engines, fallback ladder, watchdogs, diagnostics

OwnTV_Mobile/  (separate repo, the phone and tablet app on the same core)

Related repositories

  • 📱 OwnTV Mobile — the phone and tablet app, built on the same core.
  • 🧩 OwnTV Core — the shared engine both apps run on.

📚 Docs (extras/)

  • 📖 User Guide — every feature and where to find it.
  • 📄 Master Product Brief — the full as-built feature and architecture reference.

📥 Installing (Fire TV / Android TV)

Grab the signed APK from the latest release. This link always points at the newest build:

https://github.com/ahXN00/OwnTV/releases/latest/download/OwnTV.apk
  • Fire TV — install Downloader (by AFTVnews), then enter code 4308278. Enable Apps from Unknown Sources if prompted.
  • Android TV / Google TV — Downloader is on Google Play too, so the same code works. Or sideload with Send files to TV, a USB drive, or adb install OwnTV.apk.

Install only from this repository's Releases. Each release ships two APKs: OwnTV.apk (arm — every real TV box, and what the Downloader code fetches) and OwnTV-x86_64-vX.X.X.apk (emulators and rare Intel boxes).

🛠️ Building & running

Only if you want to build from source — otherwise just install the APK.

Half the app lives in the separate OwnTV_Core repository; Gradle downloads it from OwnTV's public Maven repository by itself — no account or token needed.

  1. Get the code — git clone https://github.com/ahXN00/OwnTV.git (or download the ZIP).
  2. Open it in Android Studio and let Gradle sync.
  3. Pick the build variant — standard for real devices and arm emulators, x86_64 for x86_64 emulators. This matters: the native player only loads on a matching ABI.
  4. Run ▶. Minimum Android 8.0 / API 26.

Command line: ./gradlew assembleDebug (gradlew.bat on Windows). The APK lands in app/build/outputs/apk/.

Tested on a real TCL Google TV and the Android Studio emulator (Android TV and Google TV images).

🤝 Contributing

Contributions, bug reports and ideas are welcome — open an issue or a pull request. Please keep the project's player-only, bring-your-own-source positioning and match the existing code style.

Help translate OwnTV

If your language is already available, contribute interface translations across OwnTV's six Android resource components on Hosted Weblate. If it is not listed, open a language request ticket first. A maintainer will review the request, register the locale, and prepare its base translation files on Hosted Weblate. Once the language appears on Hosted Weblate, you can start translating it there. The strings themselves live in OwnTV's core library repository, together with the language contributor guide covering identifiers, validation, and promotion policy.

🙏 Credits

OwnTV speaks 26 languages because people translate it on Weblate, which hosts the project free of charge for libre software. Thank you to Weblate and to every translator who has given the app their language.

Movie & series metadata and trailers are provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

🎨 Brand

The lowercase owntv wordmark was designed for OwnTV by @m3th0d93 in issue #227.

▶️ Playback engines

  • mpv (via libmpv, built on FFmpeg) — the default engine, for the widest IPTV/codec, audio and HDR support.
  • Media3 / ExoPlayer — the fast-start engine for Live TV preview and HLS.

Which of the two starts a stream is yours to set, separately for Live TV and for Movies & Series (Settings → Player): either order, or one engine only with the automatic handover turned off.

🧩 Built with

Jetpack Compose for TV · Room · Koin · OkHttp · Coil · ZXing — and the wider Kotlin / AndroidX open-source ecosystem. Thank you to all their maintainers. See each project for its own license.

item.description:
🎵 Hybrid music client for Android: Spotify discovery & UI + YouTube Music library + Hi-Res Lossless (FLAC) streaming with fluid Glassmorphism💫

YumaPlayer (Yuma)

A hybrid music client for Android focused on usability, clean aesthetics, and audiophile-grade sound.
Spotify UI + Discovery Algorithms + YouTube Music Library + Hi-Res Lossless (FLAC) + Smart Automix.

Showcase • Features • Architecture • Download • Contributing • Support

🌟 About the Project

YumaPlayer is an independent, open-source Android music player that unites the libraries and recommendation features of two leading streaming services alongside standalone local playback in Hi-Res quality.

The project evolved as a comprehensive rebuild of ArchiveTune (with foundations from Metrolist and SimpMusic), inspired by PixelPlayer's queue mechanics, Meld's Spotify integration pipeline, and Stash's FLAC architecture. On top of this base, YumaPlayer implements a modular 20-module architecture, a dedicated low-level audio DSP engine, the custom YDS 2.1 design system, and hardware-accelerated fluid gesture physics.

No subscriptions. No advertisements. Zero telemetry, crash reporters, or third-party trackers. All credentials live exclusively on your device, encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Google Tink, and the codebase is completely open under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

📸 Showcase

3-Tier Synced Lyrics
Queue

Immersive Artist Poster
Telegram-Style Morphing

✨ Key Features

🎛️ Audio Engine & Smart Automix

  • Dual-Deck Continuous Crossfade: True gapless and overlapping playback using two independent, synchronized audio deck controllers with atomic role swapping. Zero silence between tracks.
  • DJ Transition Intelligence: Automated outro/intro cue detection, energy cliff analysis, BPM matching, and complementary bass-swap filters (0.45–0.55 window).
  • Audiophile Codec Pipeline: Dedicated 24-bit packed PCM processing, Kopus-first Opus decoding with MediaCodec fallback, and native FLAC length resolution.
  • Smart Stall Recovery: Automatic degradation to hard cut on buffer underruns, automated stream revival upon network reconnection, and strict source-scoped cache identities.
  • N+1 Prefetching: Seamless background caching of upcoming tracks into the local download cache.

🔄 Dual Mode (Spotify + YouTube Music)

  • Spotify Catalog: In-app browsing of Spotify albums, Daily Mixes, Discover Weekly, and playlists with cross-script deduplication and locale-aware metadata.
  • YouTube Music Catalog: Full-catalog search across YouTube Music, charts, mood & genre categories, radio stations, and fast channel switching.
  • SponsorBlock Integration: Configurable in-app segment skipping for sponsor messages, music hooks, fillers, and subscription reminders.

🎧 Lossless Playback & Local Audio

  • Lossless FLAC: Stream and download true lossless FLAC tracks (via Qobuz / QBDLX backbone integration) using your own credentials or open community resolvers.
  • Seamless Fallback: If a track is unavailable in lossless catalogs, playback instantly routes through YouTube Music's high-bitrate stream (Opus / AAC).
  • Local Audio Engine: Built-in player for standalone files stored on your device (FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, WAV).
  • Audio Tuning: Built-in 5-band equalizer, EBU R128 loudness normalization, tempo and pitch adjustment, and a sleep timer.

🎨 Yuma Design System (YDS) & Fluid Motion

  • Draggable Navigation Island: Compact floating navigation dock inspired by Telegram specifications, featuring dynamic corner morphing, scroll-hide sync, and local haptic feedback.
  • Unified Player Sheet V2: Re-engineered gesture physics with GPU-accelerated backdrop blur (Haze), isolated drag layers, and independent artwork scaling.
  • Canvas Video Backdrops: Hardware-accelerated background video loops supporting up to 4K resolution with an isolated cache.
  • Spoiler Veil: Interactive Telegram-grade particle engine to obscure tokens and sensitive settings.
  • Dynamic Monet Theming: Adaptive palette extraction powered by the currently playing track's artwork, tuned for strict WCAG contrast compliance.

🎤 Synchronized Lyrics & AI Translation

  • 3-Tier Synchronized Display: Simultaneous live display of original lyrics (Kanji / Hangul), pronunciation guide (Romaji), and translated lines.
  • Live Karaoke Scrolling: Word-by-word and line-by-line sync pulled from 6+ providers (LRCLIB, Kugou, BetterLyrics, SimpMusic, Unison, YouLyPlus) with bounded memory allocation to prevent OOM.
  • On-the-Fly AI Translation: Instant translation of lyrics into your preferred language right inside the player.
  • Lyrics Card Sharing: Export and share formatted lyrics quote cards as clean images.

📥 Download & Installation

GitHub Releases Telegram Channel Canary Channel Obtainium

Building from Source

git clone https://github.com/MuwMx/YumaPlayer.git
cd YumaPlayer
./gradlew assembleRelease
# Built APK will be located at: app/build/outputs/apk/release/

Prerequisites: Android Studio with AGP 9.x support, JDK 21, Android SDK 37 (compileSdk/targetSdk 37, minSdk 26).

🏛️ Architecture & Tech Stack

YumaPlayer is organized as a 20-module Clean Architecture project following Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF):

  • UI & Presentation: Jetpack Compose, YDS 2.1 design tokens, GPU-accelerated Haze overlays, fluid gesture physics.
  • Audio Engine: Media3 (ExoPlayer), :core:audio-dsp (Smart Automix, dual-deck continuous crossfader, DJ filter cascade).
  • Network & Ingestion: :core:innertube (YouTube Music engine), Ktor/Retrofit, SOCKS5 proxy support with JVM Authenticator.
  • Storage & Security: Room ORM, hardware-backed secure preferences (AES-256-GCM via Google Tink).
